set.st: Bogus Bluff is the counterfeiters' cave near Gotham, with an 1828 treasure legend. The La Crosse Tribune of April 15, 1923 (p. 9) confirms this is the bluff: the cave is about 200 ft from the north bank of the Wisconsin River, adventurers dug it over 1922-23, and they found nothing. The digging began in 1921, when two strangers with a blueprint reopened an old west entrance and sealed it on leaving; in January 1922 the landowner gave a mining engineer a year's exclusive right to dig (Epitaph-News, 19 Jan 1922). Pin is the GNIS point for the bluff.
set.tovw: Lead grade D: legend; the 1921-23 digs are documented in two local papers, nothing found; state riverway, look-only
pinev: Placed on GNIS Bogus Bluff (cliff); the cave is about 200 ft from the north bank of the Wisconsin River (La Crosse Tribune 15 Apr 1923)
